# Timer:name

<div class="api-badges"><span class="api-badge api-badge--since">since 1.1.0</span></div>

Get / Set the timer name.

```lua
local name = timer:name([name])
```

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | string | optional |  |

## Returns

name (string)

## Examples

```lua title="From the official Ethos documentation"
timer = model.getTimer(0)
timer:name("My timer")
print(timer:name())
```
